market_pulse.theme: Regulatory crackdowns and new licensing in emerging markets
market_pulse.narrative: Multiple regulators across Africa and Asia are tightening gambling rules, issuing new licenses, and enforcing stricter compliance – e.g., Rwanda licensing Betway, ElephantBet and ForteBet; Thailand tightening online gambling and targeting AI‑powered networks; Kenya imposing penalties for late payouts; Mozambique introducing SMS ad restrictions; Brazil expanding financial enforcement; Ireland flagging AML risks.

market_pulse.theme: Rise of prediction markets and related regulatory attention
market_pulse.narrative: Prediction markets are gaining mainstream interest, highlighted by tribal gaming leaders lobbying in Washington, the Love Island betting craze, Meta’s planned prediction‑markets app, and executive exits at Crypto.com’s prediction‑markets division.

market_pulse.theme: New slot releases and product reviews
market_pulse.narrative: Several new online slots are being launched and reviewed, indicating a focus on fresh content to attract players – examples include Coco Rush, Golden Empire 1000, Pocket Games Soft slots, and Reel of Ra.

market_pulse.theme: Regulatory crackdown on prediction markets and gambling platforms
market_pulse.narrative: Multiple European regulators (France, Ireland, Germany, Netherlands) and African authorities (South Africa) are tightening rules on prediction markets and illegal gambling sites, leading to bans, ISP blocks, and legal challenges.

market_pulse.theme: World Cup impact on iGaming revenue and market dynamics
market_pulse.narrative: The 2026 FIFA World Cup is driving betting volume spikes for operators like Betsson while putting pressure on traditional casino revenues in Macau and reshaping demand across African markets.
